thread:
amanda: Quick heads-up — planning a canary cutover tomorrow for multi-region active/active fallback. Need to validate (1) residency header preservation, (2) KV cache priming across standby region, (3) canary routing respects capacity tiers. Who can triage infra-side checks?
kevin: I can. scope?
amanda: We'll spin up a small canary tenant on eu-west + us-west. Traffic -> eu primary, then flip to us as canary with 1% traffic. Watch latencies and GEO header. Deploy will use /routing/canary flag.
leah: Add me for telemetry — I'll instrument p50/p99 delta, prefix cache hit rate, and model variant fallback counts.
josh: FYI deploy-bot will emit canary events. Add a health-check endpoint we can poll: /_internal/canary_status
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled by @amanda — canary_id=canary-2026-03-22-1, started at 5234567890
sre-oncall: Oncall ack, will watch for error spikes. What's rollback plan?
amanda: rollback = immediate: set canary_traffic=0 via console or `curl -XPOST https://console.redwood.internal/api/canaries -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"canary":0}'` — quick command in runbook below.
kevin: Also watch residency mismatch logs: "residency-mismatch: tenant=<id> expected=eu-west actual=us-west" — if we see >0.1% ops then abort.
leah: sending telemetry dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/multi-region/canary-5234567890
josh: small snippet for health check:
```
curl -H "X-Redwood-Residence: eu-west" https://edge.internal/_internal/canary_status | jq .
```
amanda: Also validate KV priming: run `redis-cli -h standby.redis --scan --pattern "canary:*"` on standby, check prefix cache keys and TTLs.
sre-oncall: If we see fallback-to-hosted-model, is that expected?
amanda: No — fallback should be to local compatible quantized variant, not hosted. If hosted fallback appears, immediate abort and set canary_traffic=0.
kevin: I'll wire an alert: if p50 increases > 200ms or fallback_count > 10 in 5m, page oncall.
leah: noted. Will add visual thresholds and include prompt-level eval drop alerts (score delta > 3pts).
josh: one more: verify tokenization parity between model variants. mismatch can cause hallucinations or length differences.
amanda: Great. Plan: roll 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m with 15m observation per step. Starting 09:00 PDT tomorrow. Any objections?
sre-oncall: none. +1
deploy-bot: canary progress: step=1 pct=1 status=running
amanda: If everything stable, we'll promote to 100% in dedicated cluster at 03:00 UTC and then run a full cache-warm job. Postmortem doc link after.
kevin: I'll post quick runbook snippet to #eng-oncall as well and attach the rollback commands.
leah: I'll capture a small eval prompt set to run across both regions to detect regressions and push results into evals/summaries.
josh: 👍
amanda: thanks all — will DM the pager creds to @sre-oncall and post the final kickoff in #release-war-room prior to start.
